```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

## Workflow requirements {#workflow-requirements}

Use a genetic reference panel matched to the GWAS ancestry and genome build.
The default database uses GRCh37. Convert coordinates from other builds and
check marker identity and allele orientation before ingestion. Required fields
are `chr`, `pos`, `ea`, `nea`, `b`, `seb`, and `p`. Supply study effect-allele
frequencies as `eaf` when available. When `eaf` is omitted, gact uses the marker
catalog frequencies, so the study-to-reference frequency check needs study EAF.

Review the mappings returned by `detectStatSchema()` when using automatic
mapping. Use `effect_scale = "beta"` for a beta or log-odds column and
`effect_scale = "or"` for odds ratios from a column with a different name.
By default, `ingestStatDB()` converts columns named `OR` or `odds_ratio` to
log odds. Supply `seb` on the same scale as the resulting effect estimate.


## Introduction
This tutorial is designed for incorporating new genetic association data into an existing gact database. The example below is for the UK Biobank 2021 Glycated Hemoglobin (HbA1c) GWAS data for European ancestry.

<br>

```{r all-code, include=TRUE, eval=FALSE}
# Load libraries
library(gact)
library(data.table)


# Load GAlist with information on gact database
GAlist <- readRDS(file="C:/Users/gact/hsa.0.0.1/GAlist_hsa.0.0.1.rds")


################################################################################
# UK Biobank 2021 HbA1c GWAS: European ancestry
################################################################################
# link: https://t2d.hugeamp.org/dinspector.html?dataset=SinnottArmstrong2021_HBA1C_EU

# Load GWAS data
fname_stat <- "C:/Users/gact/hsa.0.0.1/download/Glycated_haemoglobin_HbA1c.imp.gz"
stat <- fread(fname_stat, data.table = FALSE)

# Map the study columns. This example uses catalog frequencies for EAF.
schema <- c(chr = "#CHROM", pos = "POS", ea = "ALT", nea = "REF",
            b = "Effect", seb = "StdErr", p = "P-value")

result <- ingestStatDB(
  GAlist, stat, schema = schema, effect_scale = "beta",
  source = "Glycated_haemoglobin_HbA1c.imp", trait = "HbA1c",
  type = "quantitative", gender = "both", ancestry = "EUR",
  build = "GRCh37", reference = "PMID:33462484", n = 318779
)
GAlist <- result$GAlist

# Save updated database
saveRDS(GAlist, file="C:/Users/gact/hsa.0.0.1/GAlist_hsa.0.0.1.rds", compress = FALSE)


```
